disputes.a: PowerPyx, KeenGamer, GTAScoop: 18 spots for the trophy.
disputes.b: CryptoGames / EGamers (via GTABase): 15 for the 100% checklist.
disputes.call: Both right — trophy needs 18, checklist needs 15. Different counts, different requirements.
disputes.title: Meditations: 18 or 15?

disputes.a: PowerPyx: unclear — the author did it and earned the trophy.
disputes.call: Do it anyway, and make a manual save first. It costs 2 minutes and protects the Platinum.
disputes.title: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation required?

disputes.a: TechWiser (via CryptoGames / EGamers): five hidden trophies' stranger chains have windows tied to story progress.
disputes.b: PowerPyx: all trophy quest givers return after the story.
disputes.call: Start chains when they unlock; do not rely on post-story availability alone.
disputes.title: Stranger chains: time-limited?

disputes.a: PowerPyx: full method — rob the same Payday Loans again as Lucia, on foot.
disputes.call: Follow PowerPyx — it is specific and testable.
disputes.title: Bad Luck, I Guess: method known?

disputes.a: PowerPyx: bike kick 10 pedestrians in 60 seconds.
disputes.title: Ten Pin: method known?

disputes.a: TechForNerd: start it as soon as it appears; one checklist warns it may expire.
disputes.b: PowerPyx: time-sensitive quests fail but are not trophy-relevant.
disputes.call: Do Yago's chain promptly in Chapter 3.
disputes.title: Race Against Yago: does it expire?

save_plan.rule: Make a manual save at the start AND the end of each chapter (10 saves). Rotate the remaining 5 for free-roam cleanup. NEVER overwrite the pre-Tourist-Trap Chapter 1 save — it is your only way back to the one missable meditation.

stages.name: Chapters 1–2 — start strong, save early
stages.note: Story start + the ONE missable meditation. Make your first chapter saves.

stages.name: Chapters 3–5 — finish the story
stages.note: Story finale gold + Chapter 3–5 story trophies. Story total 60–80 h.

stages.name: 100% Completion grind
stages.note: The long gate: 300 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, races, collectibles.

stages.name: Side quests & crime
stages.note: Stranger finales, bank vaults, shops, garages. Start chains when they unlock (D3).

stages.name: Secrets, cleanup & Platinum
stages.note: Hidden misc trophies, UFO, bowling, tank, plane — then the Platinum pops.
